routes.name: cta-review-and-sign-employment-offer-letter
click: Review and sign Employment Offer Letter

notes.themes: The app keeps the theme in sessionStorage, not localStorage; the browser check sets it through ?theme=light|dark, which the app reads at startup (src/index.html).
notes.complete route: /complete/:documentId redirects to /documents unless a document was signed in this session; the reference journey (frontend/react/journey-check.mjs, run against this port) covers it.
notes.colourRules: None: the app has no chart or banded value (reference app-plan.md, Colour semantics).
notes.server: Production build served by ng serve --configuration production on port 5180, from the root (source-only port, no base path).
